notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35377707/7ddee3b0c54210d96016c7c5a4a377d63bb32922.png[/img]

What sort of present is ideal for Valentine's Day?

Flowers? 🌹 Clothes? 👕 

For a gamer? 

GAMES!! 🎮

As a token of our love for gamers on the occasion of the Valentine's Day celebration, we have prepared special discounts for nearly all Gaming Factory games with a bundle cheaper than a bouquet of flowers.

Check it out: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24600/Valentine_Indie_Games_Bundle/



Let's celebrate together. Keep smiling and have fun playing.

Gaming Factory Team

notes.title: Castle Flipper - Premiere
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Folks![/h2]

I know you wait for some content from this game but our friends have a premiere of Castle Flipper. 

Along with it comes:


•	[b]Stream[/b] that should start in few moments
•	[b]Giveaway[/b] - for the best Medieval jokes we will be offering some Steam Keys of Castle Flipper
•	[b]Great deal[/b] on launch with very nice price - just 18.99$ - 15%
•	[b]Royalty bonus[/b] for those who own House Flipper or/and Train Station Renovation


•	Be quick! The offer lasts between [b]May 26 – June 2[/b]

[b]Get "Castle Flipper" here:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/944250/Castle_Flipper

[previewyoutube=Z4Rp17Tuiyg;full][/previewyoutube]


Go & make Medieval Times great again!

notes.title: Game Announcement and Question to Community
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Celebrities![/h1]

Today we have announced our new game: [b][u]Celebrity Life[/u][/b]
It's a HUGE task. We are more then delighted to forge our idea and Your dreams to Code and Game!

Part of [b]Gaming Factory[/b] Credo is to create a game altogether with its community so we would like to ask You a question:

[h3][b]"[u]What kind of Celebrity would You like to become in our game[/u]?"[/b][/h3]

You can post Your answers here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1459990/discussions/0/2987537248821542207/
Or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/GTyR9ZC]Discord Server.[/url]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/GTyR9ZC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39149589/34ca32c4fa77b7c22e3ca3fa6c486464fd95fe33.png[/img][/url]

Our goal is to create a game that will be reviewable just as [b]Dave Chappelle[/b] once said:
"[i]I love being famous - it's phenomenal.[/i]"

[b]But for now, stay tuned for more awesome stuff on our Discord or Social Media![/b]
https://linktr.ee/GamingFactorySA

Don't forget to Add [b]Celebrity Life[/b] to [b]Your Wishlist[/b] ;)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1459990/Celebrity_Life/
